intro.h2: A new kitchen look without tearing out your cabinets
paragraphs: Morris Finishing Company does kitchen cabinet refinishing in Dublin, Virginia, for homeowners who like their layout but not their finish. Instead of ripping out solid cabinets, the crew refinishes and paints them, and can add new doors, drawer fronts, hardware and trim.

One family bought a house with red maple cabinets they wanted to bring into the 21st century. They picked a color, Chuck and Mike did the work, and the family says they are amazed at the transformation. The whole process took about a week. Customers name Chuck, Susan and Mike, and call them honest, diligent and easy to work with.

about.text: Morris Finishing Company LLC works from 549 E Main St in Dublin, Virginia. Its focus is the finish: refinishing and painting kitchen cabinets, adding new doors and drawer fronts, custom moldings and trim, and interior painting. Customers get to know Susan, who they call to get started, and Chuck and Mike, who do the work. Reviews go back eight years, from a Cape Cod style home painted inside to recent two-tone cabinet refinishes, and they keep using the same words: honest, professional and detail oriented.

image.alt: Long kitchen with white tall cabinets, navy lower cabinets, dark granite and a bay window

steps.title: Call Susan and Chuck
steps.text: Call (540) 674-0079 on a weekday between 8 AM and 4 PM to talk about your kitchen and what you would like to change.

steps.title: Walk through the process
steps.text: Susan and Chuck explain how refinishing works for your cabinets, as one reviewer put it, and answer your questions.

steps.title: Pick your color
steps.text: Choose your color, or a two-tone combination. Chuck can offer suggestions if you want help deciding what will look best.

steps.title: Chuck and Mike do the work
steps.text: The crew refinishes your cabinets. Reviewers say the whole process takes about a week, and the look is worth the wait.

steps.title: Enjoy the transformation
steps.text: Walk through the finished kitchen together and check every door and drawer before the crew wraps up.

service_area.text: Morris Finishing Company is based at 549 E Main St in Dublin, Virginia, and Dublin is the town named on its Google and Facebook pages. If you want your kitchen cabinets refinished, a two-tone update or interior painting in or around Dublin, call (540) 674-0079 on a weekday to check that your home is in their area and talk through your project.

items.q: How long does cabinet refinishing take?
items.a: It depends on the size of the kitchen, so ask when you call. One Google reviewer, who had red maple cabinets refinished in a new color, said the whole process takes about a week, and that the look was worth the wait.

items.q: Can you refinish my cabinets instead of replacing them?
items.a: That is the core of what Morris Finishing does. They refinish and paint existing kitchen cabinets, and can add new doors, drawer fronts and hardware for a bigger change. Their own posts note that renewing what you have can leave money in the budget for other upgrades.

items.q: Can you help me choose a color?
items.a: Yes. Reviewers say Chuck offered suggestions and helped them choose colors with amazing results, and customers have picked everything from white to taupe to two-tone navy and white. Ask to see examples of past kitchens when you call to plan your project.

Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 4 PM, closed Saturday and Sunday. You can also email r.mooris@morrisfinishing.com with photos of your kitchen and a note about the color or look you have in mind, and the team will follow up with you.

items.q: Do you do painting outside the kitchen?
items.a: Yes. One family had Morris Finishing paint the interior of their Cape Cod style home and praised Chuck and his crew as polite and trustworthy. Their Facebook page also offers custom moldings and trim, and they have shared a log home project there too.

final_cta.text: Call Susan and Chuck to talk about colors and timing.
